versions.name: Motorboating
versions.description: Fuel and start a motorboat, run a course of passes, turns, and stops, anchor in open water, dock and moor it, and tie the cleat hitch, bowline, and clove hitch that hold everything fast.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
